title: rust-analyzer Container Environment Configuration
description: Environment variables supported by the rust-analyzer language server container.

RA_LOG.title: rust-analyzer log filter
RA_LOG.description: Tracing filter passed through to rust-analyzer, for example info or rust_analyzer=debug.

RUST_LOG.title: Rust log filter
RUST_LOG.description: Generic Rust tracing/log filter for helper tools launched by rust-analyzer.

RUST_BACKTRACE.title: Rust backtraces
RUST_BACKTRACE.description: Controls whether Rust tools emit backtraces on panic.

CARGO_HOME.title: Cargo home
CARGO_HOME.description: Cargo cache/configuration directory used by cargo, clippy, and rust-analyzer.

RUSTUP_HOME.title: Rustup home
RUSTUP_HOME.description: Optional rustup state directory if a mounted toolchain is provided.
